purpose: Critical Big Tech research scoping review

entries.title: AlphaProof Code: Verifying Signal's Security at the Machine-Code Level
entries.release: proof artifacts; not the full multi-agent proprietary prover
entries.result: ~6.5M lines of Lean checked against ~26k lines of trusted specifications/AArch64 semantics; 2 historical bugs tested
entries.caveat: Proof covers stated properties and threat model only; trusted specification and binary extraction assumptions require human review
entries.relevance: Formal invariants for signer, revocation, authorization, queue; trusted gatekeeper

entries.title: Scientist One / Science One: Verifiable Autonomous Research via Chain of Evidence
entries.release: concept and experimental description; no verified production code
entries.result: Research abstract reports 60 papers, 0/830 phantom references, 7/15 method-code alignment; blog reports 75 papers for a differing evaluation cohort
entries.caveat: Report/blog sample sizes differ; zero fabricated references is not proof all claims are true
entries.relevance: Evidence graph connecting research claims, metrics and exact code/artifacts

entries.title: Code World Model
entries.release: open weights/model card and inference/reproduction code
entries.result: 32B model midtrained on Python and Docker observation-action trajectories
entries.caveat: No evidence it matches frontier proprietary coding agents across all workloads
entries.relevance: Test whether environment dynamics models improve patch proposals

entries.title: V-JEPA 2.1: dense video world representations
entries.release: code, partial checkpoints/configs
entries.result: Temporal dense representations and action-conditioned world model from pretrained video encoder
entries.caveat: Some public checkpoint availability/config issues reported on Github; test exact checkpoint/tag
entries.relevance: Video continuity evaluation and motion embeddings; not generative video replacement

entries.title: Genie 4 interactive multimodal world simulation
entries.release: waitlist/model access not public OSS
entries.result: Interactive visual/audio world simulation claims
entries.caveat: No downloadable weights or independently benchmarked reproducible release verified
entries.relevance: Reference architecture for interactive cinematic worlds; not direct integration

entries.title: Training activation classifiers for safety and alignment
entries.release: research description; no general public reusable probe weights
entries.result: Synchronous per-token activation probes; up to 1M supervised training examples and >=32 random initializations per setting reported
entries.caveat: Requires hidden activations, labels, retraining after model changes and independent false positive tests
entries.relevance: Experimental in-model monitor for self-hosted LLMs

entries.title: Open sourcing CoT monitorability evaluations
entries.release: public data subsets and scoring code, not private incident evals
entries.result: Intervention/process/outcome eval metrics, cross-fit filtering
entries.caveat: Reasoning visibility is imperfect and can degrade under training
entries.relevance: Monitorability evaluation benchmark independent of coding success

entries.title: Auto-review of agent actions without synchronous human oversight
entries.release: implemented in Codex; internal reviewer model not open weights
entries.result: ~200x fewer human interruptions in authors' setting; 99% of reviewed actions approved
entries.caveat: Reviewer is not a deterministic policy enforcement point
entries.relevance: Risk-tiered proposals and approval for boundary-crossing actions

entries.title: Eval-production behavior gaps and objective awareness
entries.release: study only
entries.result: Safety eval-production gap 10.2–37.4pp in six models; objective framing intervention shifted outcomes
entries.caveat: Matched production case mix approximate; CoT statements are only proxy beliefs
entries.relevance: Avoid optimizing exclusively for static safety benchmarks

entries.title: What affects CoT monitorability across model lifecycle
entries.release: study only
entries.result: Architecture and RL/model-generated data affect controllability and proxies for monitorability
entries.caveat: CoT proxy is not direct access to model intent
entries.relevance: When tuning LLMs, assess safety monitoring degradation

entries.title: AuditBench: models with implanted concealed behaviors
entries.release: released 56 target models plus auditing framework; links on official article
entries.result: 56 concealed-behavior models, 14 behaviors, 13 tool configurations
entries.caveat: Synthetic concealed targets and expensive 70B target models; black box auditor does not guarantee uncovering hidden behaviors
entries.relevance: Adversarial auditor evals with independent target and calibrated controls

entries.title: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning
entries.release: Petri public; specialized RL training artifacts must be separately checked
entries.result: Pairwise reward with benign-target calibration avoids some reward hacking; small auditor competitive with larger on specific audit suite
entries.caveat: Single numeric reward trained auditor to manufacture findings; generalization is limited
entries.relevance: Train independent reviewer on pairwise evidence rather than fabricated alert count

entries.title: NeMo Gym 0.7.0
entries.release: open source (v0.7.0), environment servers and verifiers
entries.result: Retokenized trajectories, reverify stored rollouts, supports many harnesses, GPU/Slurm workers
entries.caveat: CI environment and model eval frameworks do not imply safe execution of arbitrary code by default
entries.relevance: Richer reproducible experimentation and offline regrading

entries.title: Agent Explorative Policy Optimization
entries.release: paper/project resources; verify code availability before adoption
entries.result: ~30% tool-use in baseline training rollouts; +1.8pp Pass@1 and Pass@4 vs GRPO for studied 8B
entries.caveat: Specialized multimodal tool-use task; gains on coding agents not established
entries.relevance: RL that resamples failed tool-call branches rather than whole trajectories

entries.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Harnessed Agentic RL
entries.release: public RL training scripts
entries.result: Qwen3.5-9B SWE-bench Verified 41.8% to 56.4%, 6K examples, approx 3500-line harness
entries.caveat: Developer-reported model-specific result; training cost and actual tasks need calibration
entries.relevance: Make deployment harness participate in RL data collection

entries.title: Agent World Model: 1000 synthetic executable tool environments
entries.release: synthesis pipeline, dataset and checkpoints
entries.result: 1000 database-backed tool-use environments with verifiable state transitions
entries.caveat: Attribution is Snowflake/UNC; appearance on Microsoft Research page does not make it Microsoft-owned
entries.relevance: Synthetic CRM/legal/finance workflows with deterministic success checks

entries.title: Dogwood temporal governance language
entries.release: reference interpreter; not for production
entries.result: Policy conditions may constrain tool call based on past events and time windows
entries.caveat: Temporal traces and clock integrity are part of trust assumptions
entries.relevance: External authorization with ordered approval/test/commit constraints

entries.title: Dogwood Local Engine
entries.release: Apache-2.0 incremental authorization engine
entries.result: Durably maintains derived state and provides incremental temporal authorization decisions
entries.caveat: No built-in immutable audit log; clock correctness and service hardening necessary
entries.relevance: Candidate policy PEP/PDP replacing ad hoc temporal checks

entries.title: Strands Box agent sandbox with Dogwood policies
entries.release: open source software
entries.result: OS-level access restrictions with policy gateway/broker for mediated operations
entries.caveat: Only mediated operations covered; isolation boundaries must be independently validated
entries.relevance: Layered sandboxing for code/browser agents

entries.title: Infinity: stackless coroutine agent runtime
entries.release: Apache-2.0 Rust runtime
entries.result: Author demo: 75k idle agents fit Raspberry Pi 5 with 8GB; suspended threads reconstructed from stored histories
entries.caveat: Memory capacity is NOT LLM throughput; event authenticity, scheduling and long-horizon compaction open questions
entries.relevance: Cheap dormant work queues and concurrent model/tool scheduling

entries.title: ExTS: exploit more, explore smarter
entries.release: open source search policy
entries.result: Average relative +5.5% over selected search baselines across studied optimization tasks
entries.caveat: Specific search spaces and evaluator budgets, measure cost per correct solution
entries.relevance: Budget-aware decision to deepen or branch autonomous research

entries.title: aws-bench for agent infrastructure operations
entries.release: open source benchmark requiring disposable AWS accounts
entries.result: Reproducible infrastructure diagnostic and mutation tasks with verifiers
entries.caveat: Creates real paid resources; never run on production accounts or without explicit spend budget
entries.relevance: Later-stage cloud ops agent verification

entries.lab: IBM Research / UC Berkeley et al.
entries.title: Characterizing Agents in Production
entries.release: research study
entries.result: 306 practitioners, 20 cases, 68% agents <=10 steps before intervention; 74% primarily human evaluation
entries.caveat: Survey self-selection and time-2026 bias
entries.relevance: Favor simple limited controllers and human oversight over agent swarm complexity

entries.title: ST-WebAgentBench
entries.release: modular framework according to authors; verify repository
entries.result: 375 tasks, 3057 policies, Completion under Policy <2/3 nominal success for studied agents
entries.caveat: Three evaluated agents and tasks may not represent finance/notarial systems
entries.relevance: Safety-adjusted task completion as primary browser agent metric

entries.title: Process-Centric Analysis of Agentic Software Systems
entries.release: paper + separate Graphectory Viewer code reported
entries.result: 4000 coding trajectories; online intervention reported 6.9-23.5% improvement for selected problematic instances
entries.caveat: Analyzed problematic subset; cannot generalize relative improvement to all work
entries.relevance: Structural anomaly detection across action graphs, not only success labels

entries.title: Tangent: Testing Practices for LLM Agent Applications
entries.release: research study
entries.result: 2572 test methods from 240 modules; widespread shallow mocks and weak scenario coverage
entries.caveat: Sampled repos and labels cannot measure every production test setup
entries.relevance: Need stateful contract tests, fault injection and external verification
